jobs.title: Maintenance jobs
jobs.intro: Periodic tasks run by the scheduler service: data purges and read-only checks. Running a job files a request: the scheduler picks it up within a few seconds, after the pass in progress if there is one.
jobs.loadError: Couldn't load the job status. Check your connection, then try again.

scheduler.noStatus: No status published by the scheduler
scheduler.noStatusHint: It's stopped or hasn't started yet: a requested pass will wait for it to start, and expires if it waits too long.
scheduler.controlDownHint: Redis isn't responding: the scheduler status and manual runs are unavailable. The last passes are still shown.

skipReasons.retention_disabled: Pass skipped: the task is disabled (retention 0).
skipReasons.schema_not_current: Pass skipped: the database schema wasn't up to date (pending migration).
skipReasons.busy: Pass skipped: another job held the lock for too long.

jobs.requested: Pass requested: {{job}}. The scheduler starts it within a few seconds.

errors.conflict: This job is already requested or running.
errors.controlDown: The control channel (Redis) isn't responding: a pass can't be requested right now.
errors.forbidden: Your account no longer has access to administration.
errors.generic: The request didn't go through. Try again in a moment.
errors.refresh: Couldn't refresh the job status. Try again in a moment.

ai_usage_counters.label: AI quota counters
ai_usage_counters.description: Deletes the daily call counters of the default AI older than the retention.

tool_turn_content.label: Tool turn content
tool_turn_content.description: Trims the content of the assistant's tool results (PDF reads…) past the retention. The messages remain.

ai_conversations.label: Assistant conversations
ai_conversations.description: Deletes assistant conversations with no activity since the retention.

exercise_submissions.label: Student attempts
exercise_submissions.description: Deletes exercise attempts older than the retention.

share_links.label: Expired share links
share_links.description: Deletes share links that expired longer ago than the retention.

pending_resources.label: Never-confirmed resources
pending_resources.description: Deletes resources whose upload was never confirmed, along with their S3 object.

s3_orphans.label: S3 bucket orphans
s3_orphans.description: Deletes S3 objects that no database row references (in dry-run mode, only logs them).

missing_s3_objects.label: Missing S3 objects
missing_s3_objects.description: Read-only check: finds rows whose S3 object has disappeared. Rotating coverage, bounded on each pass.

storage_inventory.label: Storage inventory
storage_inventory.description: Read-only check: rows per table, bytes on disk, S3 objects and bytes per prefix.
